newsitem.title: USA: Kash n' Karry names Ronald Dennis president.
newsitem.headline: Kash n' Karry names Ronald Dennis president.

text.p: Kash n' Karry Food Stores Inc said on Thursday it named Ronald Dennis president, effective immediately.
He replaced Ronald Johnson, who left Kash n' Karry following Food Lion Inc's acquisition of the 100-store supermarket chain December 18, the company said.
Prior to joining Kash n' Karry, Dennis worked for the past 20 years with the Albertson's Inc supermarket chain and served for the past five years as division vice president.
Kash n' Karry is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Food Lion Inc and operates 100 supermarkets.
